863: 	}
864: 
865: 	/**
866: 	 * Returns the output format for the thumbnail.
867: 	 * <p>
868: 	 * If the output format is to use the same compression format as the
869: 	 * original image, this method will return
870: 	 * {@link ThumbnailParameter#ORIGINAL_FORMAT}.
871: 	 * <p>
872: 	 * If the output format should be determined from the information available
873: 	 * such as the file name of the thumbnail, then this method will return
874: 	 * {@link ThumbnailParameter#DETERMINE_FORMAT}.
875: 	 * 
876: 	 * @return 		The output format for the thumbnail.
877: 	 */
878: 	public String getOutputFormat() {
879: 		return outputFormat;
880: 	}
881: 	
882: 	/**
883: 	 * Returns the output format type for the thumbnail.
884: 	 * <p>
885: 	 * If the default compression type of the compression format is to be used,
886: 	 * then this method will return
887: 	 * {@link ThumbnailParameter#DEFAULT_FORMAT_TYPE}.
888: 	 *
889: 	 * @return 		The output format type for the thumbnail.
890: 	 */
891: 	public String getOutputFormatType() {
892: 		return outputFormatType;
893: 	}
894: 
895: 	/**
896: 	 * Returns the compression quality settings for the thumbnail.
897: 	 * <p>
898: 	 * The value is in the range of {@code 0.0f} to {@code 1.0f},
899: 	 * where {@code 0.0f} is for the lowest quality setting and {@code 1.0f} for
900: 	 * the highest quality setting.
901: 	 * <p>
902: 	 * If the default compression quality is to be used, then this method will
903: 	 * return {@link ThumbnailParameter#DEFAULT_QUALITY}.
904: 	 * 
905: 	 * @return 		The compression quality settings for the thumbnail.
906: 	 */
907: 	public float getOutputQuality() {
908: 		return outputQuality;
909: 	}
910: 
911: 	/**
912: 	 * Returns the list of {@link ImageFilter}s which are applied to the
913: 	 * thumbnail.
914: 	 * <p>
915: 	 * These filters are applied after the original image has been resized.
916: 	 * 
917: 	 * @return		The {@link ImageFilter}s which are applied to the thumbnail.
918: 	 */
919: 	public List<ImageFilter> getImageFilters() {
920: 		return filters;
921: 	}
922: 	
923: 	/**
924: 	 * Returns the default {@link Resizer} that will be used when performing the
925: 	 * resizing operation to create a thumbnail.
926: 	 * 
927: 	 * @return		The default {@link Resizer} to use when performing a resize
928: 	 * 				operation.
929: 	 */
930: 	public Resizer getResizer() {
931: 		return resizerFactory.getResizer();
932: 	}
933: 	
934: 	/**
935: 	 * Returns the {@link ResizerFactory} for obtaining a {@link Resizer} which
936: 	 * is to be used when performing the resizing operation to create a
937: 	 * thumbnail.
938: 	 * 
939: 	 * @return		The {@link ResizerFactory} to use to obtain the
940: 	 * 				{@link Resizer}.
941: 	 */
942: 	public ResizerFactory getResizerFactory() {
943: 		return resizerFactory;
944: 	}
945: 	
946: 	/**
947: 	 * Returns whether or not the original image type should be used for the
948: 	 * thumbnail.
949: 	 * 
950: 	 * @return		{@code true} if the original image type should be used,
951: 	 * 				{@code false} otherwise.
952: 	 */
953: 	public boolean useOriginalImageType() {
954: 		return imageType == ORIGINAL_IMAGE_TYPE;
955: 	}
956: 	
957: 	/**
958: 	 * Returns the region of the source image to use when creating a thumbnail,
959: 	 * represented by a {@link Region} object.
960: 	 * 
961: 	 * @return		The {@code Region} object representing the source region
962: 	 * 				to use when creating a thumbnail.
963: 	 * 				<p>
964:      * 				A value of {@code null} indicates that the entire source
965:      * 				image should be used to create the thumbnail.
966: 	 */
967: 	public Region getSourceRegion() {
968: 		return sourceRegion;
969: 	}
970: 	
971: 	/**
972: 	 * Returns whether or not to fit the thumbnail within the specified
973: 	 * dimensions.
974: 	 * 
975: 	 * @return		{@code true} is returned when the thumbnail should be sized
976: 	 * 				to fit within the specified dimensions, if the thumbnail
977: 	 * 				is going to exceed those dimensions.
978: 	 * @since	0.4.0
979: 	 */
980: 	public boolean fitWithinDimenions() {
981: 		return fitWithinDimensions;
982: 	}
983: 	
984: 	/**
985: 	 * Returns whether or not the Exif metadata should be used to determine
986: 	 * the orientation of the thumbnail.
987: 	 *
988: 	 * @return		{@code true} is returned when the Exif metadata should be
989: 	 * 				used to decide the orientation of the thumbnail,
990: 	 * 				{@code false} otherwise.
991: 	 * @since	0.4.3
992: 	 */
993: 	public boolean useExifOrientation() {
994: 		return useExifOrientation;
995: 	}
996: }
